semester.audience: BS Computer Science / BS Data Science — 7th Semester
semester._comment_start_date: Set to the Monday of week 1 (e.g. 2027-01-11) to emit real dates and a downloadable .ics. Leave empty for a generic Week 1..16 calendar with no dates.
semester._comment_lab_day: Optional weekday name; if set, labs get their own calendar slot when dates are on. null = labs ride the second lecture day.
semester._comment_overrides: Optional per-week date overrides: { "6": "2027-02-22" } moves week 6's Monday. Use for public holidays and reading weeks.

week_theme.1: Foundations — the security mindset and the packets it defends
week_theme.2: Transport & application protocols, read from real captures
week_theme.3: Threat modeling and the local-network attack surface
week_theme.4: Session attacks and availability under fire
week_theme.5: Architecture begins: segmentation and egress control
week_theme.7: Cryptography: primitives and TLS in practice
week_theme.14: Recovery, SOC operations, and threat hunting
week_theme.16: Capstone: simulation, defense, and course synthesis
